summary: Wrote homily.tex with its two declared components: the spoken body (sections/homily/10-homily.tex), 1,469 words, about 11.3 to 12.2 minutes at 120 to 130 words a minute by arithmetic, with no timed delivery, for an adult parish assembly on 11 October 2026. It follows the first reading of the whole formulary (the word that heals from afar: Christ refuses the father's plan to come down and grants his prayer by a word; Gregory, Chrysostom, Aquinas, Augustine on the Gradual's due season and the Communion), with the Introit's order of prayer, the Epistle's thanks and the Offertory's exiles from the second; the third reading is left to the studies. It speaks the Augustine/Gregory disagreement on the ruler's first faith and keeps every bound of interpretations.md section 4.7 and the standing findings. The terminal note and References are in sections/homily/90-note.tex. Also: a derive-homily contribution and timestamp 2026-10-07T20:03:52Z in the shared generation record, and the production audit entry. All 30 quoted spans were re-checked at their loci (Chrysostom on the re-fetched, digest-matched NPNF1-14 facsimile; the Introit English on the re-fetched Cummiskey page image). All three editions build clean (31, 12 and 3 pages; the concise aux is unchanged) and every homily-preflight check passes locally. Upstream: only the standing research-owned STU-006 and RES-005.
